title: Presentation Spec Generalization
description: Align @framework/presentation with the spec: introduce Slide (arrangement + optional transition), generalize Morph with auto-derived bridge slides, simplify Split to tiles only, remove bespoke column/ghost/morphTarget machinery, update renderer and 33.projektetage deck.
summary: Fixed wrong Bauteilarten final frame after tile morph: hidden column-crop morph anchors were fading in at full opacity (reveal unmatched) and overlaying tiles. FigureMorphView now applies disposition style; zero-opacity crops get `presentation-morph-slot--dormant` and CSS hides them on the present slide while keeping them in DOM for focus→labels morph. Verified in browser: 10 tiles visible, cols hidden.
